owner_decision.question_verbatim: BF 上 V10 全部方法和 seed 的选择已经齐全，可以做 TEST_REPEAT134（读 held-out 的 TEST134）。现在开始吗？
owner_decision.chosen_option_text_verbatim: 先把所有方法和 seed 选中的 checkpoint 冻结成新 manifest，冻结完成前不读 TEST；然后在 TEST134 上评估。结果单独报告为重复测试，另附 112 个 core 的敏感性集，不当作独立确认。

rules.decision_6_1: 134 个官方 TEST core 已由 G1 读过，当前仍 HOLD；V10 完整协议冻结后，以新 manifest 版本启用单独的 TEST_REPEAT134 表。DEV 与 TEST_REPEAT 不合并成 166 个独立确认样本。
rules.decision_5: 完整方法集合和方法内选择全部固定以后才能启用 TEST 重复块。
rules.decision_5_claims: 必需基线补齐之前不发布方法优劣、强基线优势或新颖性比较结论。

protocol_p2_TEST.activation: TEST_REPEAT134: a separate repeated-benchmark table, only after the complete V10 freeze (common protocol, complete method set and every within-method selection), with a new manifest version
protocol_p2_TEST.pooling: DEV and TEST_REPEAT are never pooled into 166 independent confirmation samples

rules.project_memory: BF TEST134 曾在 V9-G1 读取，当前仍 HOLD。须完整 V10 方法集合、共同协议及所有方法内选择全部冻结后，创建新 manifest，以 TEST_REPEAT134 单独报告；不能与 DEV32 合并为独立 confirmation。排除 FIT/CAL 同 position 的未来 TEST_REPEAT 敏感性集为112 cores；不能提前读取它来选方法。
rules.evaluator_only: TEST_REPEAT134 rows and summaries are evaluator-only: never used for training, CAL selection, checkpoint choice, grid / candidate / protocol changes or method re-selection

data.benchmark: BF/SHG official test split (Zenodo 4550300 test.zip), 134 cores; prior exposure: V9-G1; reading began 2026-10-15T23:36:09Z
data.unit: core (one TMA core = one BF/SHG pair)

perturbations.rule: the frozen DEV rule, applied to the TEST core ids: Q.perturbations_p2(core) = REG-P1 translations (seed sha256('R6-REG-P1|<core>')[:16], magnitude strata) with theta uniform on [-30, 30] deg (seed sha256('R6-REG-P2|<core>')[:16]); per-registration position stream seed_of('R6-REG-P2|pos|<core>|<i>'); MLP extra stream seed_of('V10|MLP-extra-registration-perms|<core>|<i>')
perturbations.computed: only inside the TEST jobs (the guard gates each core like a read); every TEST row records (theta, t) and all units must share them (analysis check)
perturbations.difference_from_V9_G1: V9-G1's sealed-test read used new seed tags (V9-G1-TEST-20261015|P1 / |P2); TEST_REPEAT134 uses V10's DEV rule unchanged, so the perturbations are not V9-G1's

searcher: unchanged R6-REG-P2 (Q.optimise_rigid: coarse grid, top 3 starts, 100 Adam steps), as every V10 DEV evaluation

metrics.err_full: corner error at full resolution (px), Q.corner_error_full

sets.TEST112: 112 cores without a FIT/CAL TMA position (sensitivity set; the 22 excluded ids are frozen)

statistics.primary_unit: core; methods paired by core; the 10 perturbations of a core are not independent
statistics.per_unit: TEST134 and TEST112 metrics and per-core metrics of every frozen unit
statistics.families: primary seeds 1001-1003 summarised as seed means (hardware strata where mixed); secondary replication seeds 1004/1005 reported per unit and by hardware, never pooled with the primary seeds
statistics.paired_rule: phase2_report.paired: core score = mean over the method's primary units of the per-core success fraction (median error: median over cores of the per-core difference); RuLSIF_exact (v1) and RuLSIF_exact_v2 (A1, mixed hardware) are not contrast arms

bootstrap.resampled: cores with replacement; sensitivity: TMA position groups with replacement

statistics.dev_beside: TEST134 / TEST112 beside the same-job DEV32 re-evaluation (the paired reference) and beside the recorded DEV32; never pooled
statistics.same_job_dev_contrasts: paired contrasts on the same-job DEV32 rows with key 'TEST_REPEAT134|<A>|<B>|DEV32_same_job' (same bootstrap rule)

reporting.label: TEST_REPEAT134 (repeated benchmark; BF/SHG official test cores read once before by V9-G1; not an independent confirmation)
rules: reported as its own table, separate from DEV32; DEV32 / DEV24 shown beside it
DEV and TEST_REPEAT are never pooled (no 166-sample confirmation)
no independent-confirmation claim; prior exposure V9-G1 stated
RuLSIF_exact (v1) carries its failed-adaptation label; RuLSIF_exact_v2 carries amendment A1's label
hardware recorded per unit; secondary replication by hardware
no method-superiority, strong-baseline or novelty claim while the required baselines are not confirmed complete (decision 5)
intervals are descriptive; no significance tests
TEST134 / TEST112 are reported beside the same-job DEV32 re-evaluation (paired reference) and beside the recorded DEV32
an evaluation-noise section reports every DEV re-evaluation pair; method differences smaller than this noise are not interpretable, on DEV as well as TEST (including the main V10 DEV tables)
BLOCKED units are reported with their failed criteria; TEST is never read for them
the TEST inputs follow v5 variant A; v4's INPUT_LOCK failure and the input diagnostic are reported

hardware.rule: each unit is evaluated (DEV re-evaluation and TEST, same job) on the GPU type that produced its recorded DEV32: 28 L40S, 12 RTX6000PRO, 2 H100 (nodesumo01); --exclude=node51,node53,node60

dev_gate.criterion: bitwise: re-evaluate the gate unit's frozen selected checkpoint on DEV32 (32 cores x 10) with the TEST-stage evaluator on the GPU type that produced its record; every (core, perturbation) row present once, the same field names, and every non-timing field equal (==); DEV32 metrics equal the recorded COMPLETE DEV32; data read only FIT / CAL / DEV
dev_gate.scope: one gate per (family, GPU type) used by a TEST unit; a TEST unit runs only if its gate PASSed
dev_gate.on_fail: a FAIL is reported with its first mismatches; that family's units on that GPU type are not TEST-evaluated under this protocol; no tolerance is substituted after the fact (a criterion change needs a new protocol version and activation before any TEST read of those units); other gates and units are unaffected

criterion_by_gpu_type.L40S: bitwise: re-evaluate the gate unit's frozen selected checkpoint on DEV32 (32 cores x 10) with the TEST-stage evaluator on the GPU type that produced its record; every (core, perturbation) row present once, the same field names, and every non-timing field equal (==); DEV32 metrics equal the recorded COMPLETE DEV32; data read only FIT / CAL / DEV
criterion_by_gpu_type.RTX6000PRO: PASS if bitwise (the L40S criterion); otherwise PASS_TOLERANCE iff (a)-(d) all hold; otherwise FAIL
criterion_by_gpu_type.H100: PASS if bitwise (the L40S criterion); otherwise PASS_TOLERANCE iff (a)-(d) all hold; otherwise FAIL

tolerance_rtx6000pro_h100.a: every identity (evaluation identity file), configuration (trainer rebuild and checkpoint load), checkpoint-hash, input-hash (DATA_LOCK) and perturbation-truth field (theta, t per registration; also core, perturbation, role, checkpoint_sha256, n_grid) is bitwise identical, and every value is finite
tolerance_rtx6000pro_h100.d: the median over the 320 registrations of |delta err_full| <= 0.25
tolerance_rtx6000pro_h100.intent: catch a wrong checkpoint, wrong inputs or wrong perturbations (they shift the aggregates and the typical error by whole pixels) while admitting benign cross-hardware numerical differences, which move single pose estimates but barely the aggregate metrics (calibration: the amendment record)

recorded_by_every_gate: per-field bitwise flags and the count of bitwise-equal rows
q50, q90, q95, q99 and max of |delta err_full|, the count within 0.05 and the count identical
F_hat / F_true / theta_hat / t_hat deltas (max abs, max rel); registration rows carry no gradient
DEV32 success counts and median, recorded and re-evaluated
dev_gate.role_v4: no longer licenses TEST; every gate record (finished or still running) is an evaluation-noise sample

inputs.raw_rule: V9-G1 byte copies of the sealed archive members; sha256 must equal the frozen member list
inputs.builder: REG-P1 cmd_prepare verbatim (V9-G1's prepare path: core discovery and role assignment pointed at the test files, role TEST)
inputs.lock: INPUT_LOCK_V5.json (sha256 per prepared file); PASS requires the arrays of all 134 cores to equal V9-G1's prepared cache bitwise (criterion unchanged from v1 / v4)

job.why: the node on which the pinned kernels reproduced V9-G1's file; the build process also checks the two kernels before reading any raw member

rule.reads: summary of DIAG.json of the input diagnostic (the single diagnostic job of the core)
rule.C_stop: any value of summary.raw_members_match is not true, or summary.rebuild_deterministic is not true
rule.A: not C, summary.rebuilds_equal_to_v9_g1 is non-empty and summary.v9_cache_inside_v9_g1_prepare_window is true
rule.A_pin: the first of default_1, default_2, no_X86_V4, baseline_X86_V2 in summary.rebuilds_equal_to_v9_g1: its numpy float64 log1p and add kernels (the only CPU-dispatched kernels of REG-P1's builder); NPY_DISABLE_CPU_FEATURES disables X86_V4 when that log1p kernel is the baseline one and X86_V3 when that add kernel is; the build process checks both kernels before reading any raw member

v5.statement: A (CPU-dispatch artefact): REG-P1's frozen builder rebuilds all 134 cores into /projects/EEG-foundation-model/yinghao/outputs_v10/test_repeat134_20261020/inputs_v5 with numpy's float64 log1p / add kernels pinned to baseline(X86_V2) / X86_V3 (NPY_DISABLE_CPU_FEATURES='X86_V4'), the kernels of the diagnostic rebuild 'no_X86_V4' that reproduced V9-G1's 1B_D8 file bitwise; criterion unchanged (all 134 cores bitwise equal to V9-G1's prepared cache); TEST134, TEST112 and the 42 units unchanged
v5.limitation: 输入按 V9-G1 的 CPU 路径重建（numpy float64 log1p / add 内核固定为 baseline(X86_V2) / X86_V3），134 个 core 与 V9-G1 预处理缓存逐位相同才放行；v4 的输入（1B_D8 不同）不使用。

inputs.precondition: none beyond the frozen v5 records (the inputs job may run as soon as v5 is frozen)

jobs.resume: a TEST job that stops (time limit, node fault) is resubmitted with the same line; the frozen evaluator resumes from the completed rows of the same output, which are never replaced; COMPLETE is written once
order: inputs (CPU, cpu.sbatch inputs, variant A): writes INPUT_LOCK_V5.json once
one job per unit after INPUT_LOCK_V5 PASS: DEV32 re-evaluation, in-job check, TEST134 (on the unit's recorded DEV32 GPU type)

cost_estimate.basis: recorded DEV seconds of the unit on its own GPU type x (1340 TEST + 320 DEV) / 320 + 2 x 180 s trainer rebuilds; native allocated GPU-h; the v5 inputs job runs on CPU

version.void_draft: v3 (branch v10/test-repeat134-v3-draft, e136bd6a) was never frozen and is void
version.change: v5 inputs after v4's INPUT_LOCK failure (variant A); everything else as v4

in_job_check.order: in one process on one GPU of the unit's recorded DEV32 GPU type: re-evaluate DEV32 (32 x 10) with the TEST-stage evaluator, run this check, and only if it passes read and evaluate TEST134; otherwise the job exits non-zero, reads no TEST and records BLOCKED
in_job_check.a: identity, configuration (trainer rebuild and checkpoint load), checkpoint sha256, input hashes (DATA_LOCK), perturbation truths theta / t and n_grid are bitwise equal to the recorded unit, and every value is finite
in_job_check.e: F_true is bitwise equal in all 320 rows (the frozen energy is reproduced)
in_job_check.f: coarse gross-error band only: |delta count<42| <= 12, |delta count<9| <= 12 (of 320), |delta median err_full| <= 0.5
in_job_check.band_note: the band was set with the v1 / v2 gate re-evaluations in view (DEV only; no TEST result exists); the largest changes seen were |delta count<42| 2, |delta count<9| 7, |delta median| 0.110 over 9 re-evaluations

evaluation_noise.pairs: every DEV re-evaluation of a frozen checkpoint against its recorded DEV32 rows: the v1 / v2 gate records (any verdict, with an exit receipt) and the 42 in-job re-evaluations
evaluation_noise.statement: 评估本身有噪声：同一冻结 checkpoint 在同一 GPU 型号上重评，单次配准结果和成功计数都会变动。小于这一噪声的方法差，在 TEST 和 DEV 上都不可解释；这同样适用于 V10 的主 DEV 表。
